raw_response:
This plot is small, only a tenth of a hectare, and it is not my land — I rent it, so I will not waste my little money on chemical fertilizer for trees that are not mine. I will carry some manure from my animals when I have it, because that costs me nothing but my back. The trees are already there from before, so I do not buy seed. I just weed around them, prune a little, and watch them through the dry months. My wife and I will do the work ourselves, mostly when we pass by going to our other plots.
